# WorkCoPilot by AdmireVeda

> WorkCoPilot is a screen-aware AI work copilot. It watches your screen and
> guides you through any task step by step, with the exact command, code, setting
> or click. It catches a wrong move, corrects it, confirms each step worked, and
> keeps you on the next correct step until the job is done. It is read-only by
> design: it never clicks, types or runs anything for you. It works in the
> browser (no install, even on locked-down machines), on desktop, and on mobile.

## What it is
- A step-by-step guide for real work, across every field: technical setup and
  configuration, building and implementation, AI and automation, product,
  marketing, accounting and office work, legal and compliance, and everyday tasks.
- Security-first: every command, snippet and fix is written the secure way
  (least privilege, no hardcoded secrets, validated input) and checked before you
  run it. Sensitive data (personal data, health data, secrets, keys, card numbers)
  is stripped or tokenized on your own device before anything is sent, when data
  protection is on; the real values stay on your device.
- Each session is documented: a picture-rich write-up and an audit log.

## Plans
- Lite, Basic, Advanced, Premium (self-service, by daily guided hours) plus a
  custom-priced Enterprise plan (SSO via OIDC, company data policy, seat pools,
  a DPA). Current prices: https://admireveda.com/workcopilot/pricing

## Honesty
Claims on this site are kept to what the product actually does. WorkCoPilot
guides and corrects; it does not act on your behalf. It is not a certification or
legal advice. Compliance frameworks are supported as policy presets, not
certifications.

Contact: https://admireveda.com/workcopilot/contact
